exportClubInfo.message: A paragraph or sentence that contains several of your terms is listed once, under a header such as “cat + dog”, instead of being repeated under each term. Nothing is duplicated, the totals stay honest, and the “cat + dog” section shows where your terms appear together. Untick this to repeat the passage under every term it contains.

popupAdvanced.description: Summary of the collapsible section holding export and citation options.

popupExportHelpTitle.description: Summary/title for the collapsible export help section.

popupHintExportHelp.message: Format: Matches lists every hit. Citation adds a formatted reference (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, Vancouver, AMA or Plain) and an in-text citation after each quote. Legal is for court decisions: pick a country's style (US Bluebook, UK OSCOLA, Canada McGill, Australia AGLC, India, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, France, Italy, Spain, EU, Brazil, Portugal, Japan, Korea, China, Russia, Arabic courts, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia) and each passage gets that country's case citation. Research adds the author, date, source and section for each passage. Resume shows which terms were found, with counts, and where. Click the button once to collect the content (it may take a moment on long pages or PDFs); when it reads “Export ready: click to copy”, click it again to copy the result, then paste it where you need it.
popupHintExportHelp.description: Help text for the export Format presets.

popupHintListsHelp.message: Save your current terms under a name to reuse them later. You can keep up to 10 lists; click Delete twice to remove one and make room for another.
